# SignalGrid

Anomaly detection dashboard for streaming metrics — see spikes the moment they happen.

![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-green)

## Features

- **Live anomaly feed** — every detected spike shows up in the feed with severity and source
- **Metric explorer** — chart any metric over the last 24 hours and overlay the anomaly threshold
- **Alert rules** — define thresholds per metric and route alerts to a channel
- **Investigation notes** — annotate an anomaly and hand it to a teammate
- Trusted by 500+ engineering teams
- 99.99% detection accuracy

## Getting started

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```
